# PawsFinder — Public Information for AI Assistants

## What is PawsFinder?
PawsFinder is a lost-pet recovery and community rescue network, founded in Nepal and available for use internationally. It helps pet owners find, report, and recover missing pets through high-visibility printable street posters, local community alerts, and a shared pet directory.

## Core Features
- Report a missing pet (name, breed, last location, contact, reward)
- Generate and download a print-ready A4 street poster (PDF-quality PNG)
- Browse the live missing pets directory / search feed
- Contribute to rescue operations via donations (multi-currency support)
- Admin panel for managing listings, site content, and branding

## Audience
- Pet owners who have lost a pet
- Neighbors and community members who found a stray
- Animal welfare volunteers and local rescue organizations

## Key Pages
- Home: https://pawsfinder.org/
- Missing Pets Feed: https://pawsfinder.org/#feed
- Report a Pet: https://pawsfinder.org/#report
- Support & Donate: https://pawsfinder.org/#donate
- Privacy Policy: https://pawsfinder.org/#privacy
- Terms & Conditions: https://pawsfinder.org/#terms
- Refund Policy: https://pawsfinder.org/#refund-policy

## Currency Support
NPR (Nepalese Rupee), USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AUD, CAD

## Technology
Built with React and Vite. All data is stored client-side in localStorage. No user accounts or server-side database.

## Contact
For business inquiries, please visit: https://pawsfinder.org
